headline: Indian Equities Reclaim 25,000 Level Led by PSU Banks Amid Range-Bound Trade

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Nifty reclaimed 25,000 and Sensex surpassed 81,000 driven by gains in PSU bank stocks.
Domestic sentiment was supported by an oil price correction.
Early trade witnessed profit-taking and range-bound movement following recent Muhurat trading.
Positive cues from US stock market rally helped offset global tech sector concerns.
whatHappening: Sensex closed over 100 points higher, while Nifty settled above the 25,000 mark.
PSU Bank stocks led the market gains during the trading session.
Data Patterns saw a sharp surge of 9% during the day.
BSE and NSE will remain closed on November 10 for Diwali Balipratipada.
summary: Indian benchmark indices ended in the green with Nifty closing above 25,000 and Sensex rising over 100 points. PSU bank stocks led the gains, supported by easing crude oil prices despite early profit-taking. Both NSE and BSE will be closed tomorrow, November 10, for Diwali Balipratipada.
